state.purpose: Advisory triage of event dependencies in a general neuronal engine; never choose a solver or grant scientific PASS.

code.base: target[transmission_start:]=released(state[:n]); base neuron inputs use state[transmission_start:]. Adapter finally sets target[q_event_rows]=state[q_event_rows],rate=0 and target[s_event_rows]=state[s_event_rows],rate=0.
code.receptor: source_rows=declared_rows; activation=K*state[source_rows]*caps[source_rows]; target=activation/(activation+B);rate=activation+B. Unknown overlap between source_rows and event_rows.
code.regional: kernel computes x,b,sax targets; outer model sets target[x_rows]=state[x_rows],rate=0 and target[sax_rows]=state[sax_rows],rate=0. Reads/writes of b need inspection.

base.instructions: Classify only what the provided final dependency information establishes for base. Prefer needs_dependency_proof when index overlap or consumers remain unspecified.

criteria.discontinuous_rhs: A jump of an owned state can change a free right-hand side instantly.
criteria.continuous_filtered: Jump reaches this live equation only through continuous filtered state.
criteria.overwritten: The contribution is computed but overridden before final RHS consumption.
criteria.needs_dependency_proof: Snippet alone does not identify the final consumers or active masks.
